title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is manuscript p. 303 of the 'Variations sur l'équation des lacets'. The corner label '30' is the archive's image number; the next page is numbered 304.

Setting from the previous page. Grothendieck has written down conditions that an outer automorphism of the profinite group pi^_{0,3} must satisfy if it comes from Gamma_Q = Gal(Qbar/Q):
- pi^_{0,3} is the profinite fundamental group of P^1 minus {0,1,infinity}, a free profinite group on two generators, carrying its 'loop' (lacets) structure.
- The condition is a compatibility. The outer action on pi^_{0,3}/pi(2 infinity) must be the one induced by the character Gamma_Q -> Z^* -> Z^*/Z^{*2} -> (Z/4Z)^*.
- He left as an exercise whether this is equivalent to, or merely a consequence of, congruence conditions in C^+_{1,1}, the genus-1 (one-pointed) counterpart.

This page, first paragraph. He contrasts that exercise with a harder question.
- The question: do these conditions really cut down the group of outer automorphisms of pi^_{0,3} respecting the loop structure? This is the action of a group he writes G-check_3, essentially a Grothendieck–Teichmüller-type group.
- His verdict: this 'risque fort d'être hors de portée'. The reason is that we do not know how to construct such outer automorphisms effectively, or to exhibit non-trivial elements of C^{!*}_{0,3}, except arithmetically, through the action of Gamma_Q itself.
- In modern terms, the only known supply of elements of GT^ (or of the relevant subgroup) is the image of Gamma_Q. So one cannot test whether an extra condition is a genuine restriction on GT^. He adds that one should nonetheless make an effort in this direction some time.

This page, second paragraph. He opens a new program, continued on the next page. The aim is to reconstruct purely group-theoretically, in terms of profinite groups with loops and outer automorphisms of pi^_{0,3} or of C^+_{0,3} ≅ C^+_{1,1}:
- (a) the finer extension N_{1,1} of Gamma_Q by T^+_{1,1} ≅ SL(2,Z)^, the arithmetic fundamental group of M_{1,1};
- (b) its image in GL(2,Z^), i.e. the Galois action on the Tate module of the universal elliptic curve, at least modulo ±1.

This is the genus-1 part of the Teichmüller-tower program: describe the GT-type action on M_{1,1}.
errors: No mathematical error. The claim is a heuristic judgement of difficulty, and it remains accurate today: no element of GT^ outside the image of Gamma_Q is known, and GT^ = image of Gamma_Q is open.

ideas.what: Whether the extra (congruence/compatibility) conditions effectively restrict the group of outer automorphisms of pi^_{0,3} with loop structure. This cannot be decided because the only explicit elements come from Gamma_Q.
ideas.modern_name: GT^ versus Gal(Qbar/Q) problem; refinements of GT by extra relations (e.g. Nakamura–Schneps, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps subgroup Lambda^)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld (1990), Ihara; refinements by Lochak, Nakamura, Schneps (1990s–2000s)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme raises the question of describing Gamma_Q via the Teichmüller tower, but not in this explicit form

ideas.what: Reconstructing the arithmetic extension of Gamma_Q by SL(2,Z)^ (pi_1 of M_{1,1}) and its image in GL(2,Z^) purely in terms of profinite groups with loops and automorphisms of pi^_{0,3} ≅ the genus-(1,1) object
ideas.modern_name: GT^ action on the genus-one mapping class group / elliptic analogue (Nakamura's Galois representations on pi_1(M_{1,1}); Enriquez elliptic associators)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (sketch of the role of the (0,4) and (1,1) levels of the tower)

missed.claim: Grothendieck explicitly flags constructing non-arithmetic elements of the GT-type group (non-trivial elements of C^{!*}_{0,3}) as the key obstruction, and leaves it as an open effort. The literature has the same open problem.
missed.quote: faute de savoir construire effectivement de tels automorph. extérieurs (ou d'expliciter des éléments non triviaux de Ĉ^{!*}_{0,3}) d'une autre façon que justement par voie arithmétique
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a historical precedent (c. 1980s) for the recognized difficulty in GT theory. It is not a new mathematical result.

deep.surprise_reason: The page states, early and clearly, the now-standard obstruction in GT theory and initiates the genus-1 reconstruction program. Both themes were later developed independently (Drinfeld, Ihara, Nakamura, Schneps), so there is nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: 'l'opération de Π_Q' should read 'l'opération de Γ_Q' (Galois group of Q).
'Il faudrait quand même y refaire[?] : l'occasion un effort en ce sens' likely reads 'Il faudrait quand même refaire à l'occasion un effort en ce sens'.

The insertion '(ou d'expliciter des éléments non triviaux de Ĉ^{!*}_{0,3})' belongs after 'automorph.', and 'extérieurs' continues the phrase: 'de tels automorph. extérieurs ... d'une autre façon que...'.
The page number at the bottom ('30') is the archive's image number; the manuscript page is 303 (the next page is numbered 304).
